name: Parachuting Person Rig
blurb: A Hangar-only paratrooper silhouette under a deployed wartime personnel canopy, with the packed rig retained as a review node.
history: War Department parachute guidance described several personnel-canopy sizes, including the twenty-eight-foot class represented here. The figure, harness and suspension pose are intentionally conservative estimates around that documented canopy size.

sources.title: Department of Defense Handbook for Air Delivery Systems
